downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.55.25。选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.55.25. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 修复新建存档选择“纽约收盘”制度后，切换图表周期明显卡顿的问题，切换响应现已接近默认 UTC 模式。
highlights.en: Fixed pronounced lag when switching chart timeframes in sessions using the New York close convention, bringing responsiveness close to the default UTC mode.
